title: FLORA NELL WEATHERS vs. SRS DISTRIBUTION, INC., et al.

entries.speaker: CAPTION
entries.text:
IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE FIFTH JUDICIAL CIRCUIT, IN AND FOR MARION COUNTY, FLORIDA
CASE NO.: 24-CA-681
FLORA NELL WEATHERS, an Individual, Plaintiff, vs. SRS DISTRIBUTION, INC., a/k/a SRS ACQUISITION CORPORATION, d/b/a ROOFLINE LLC, a Foreign for Profit Corporation; and RODNEY TYRONNE FRANCIS, JR., an Individual, Defendants.

entries.speaker: THE COURT REPORTER
entries.text: Please raise your right hand for me. Do you swear or affirm that the testimony you're about to give will be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: Yes, I do.

entries.speaker: HEADING
entries.text: DIRECT EXAMINATION

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: BY MR. PARKER: Q. Good morning, Dr. Frain. Can you state your full name for the record, please?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Julianne Frain.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. And what's the name of your firm?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Rehab Pro Assessment and Consultation.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. And we are here, plaintiff Flora Weathers as identified you as a life care planner and expert to perform a life care plan; is that correct?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. That's correct.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. And where are you presently located?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. St. Louis, Missouri.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. Okay. Do you have offices in Florida?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. We have a registered business address in Florida because the business has primarily been a Florida-based corporation for over ten years now, but we do not have a physical full-time office any longer, we forfeited a physical office space in 2024 and all of my staff works remotely.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. Okay. And how many -- let me ask you this: Are you the sole owner of --

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Yes.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. Rehab Pro?

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. Are there any other owners -- you're the sole owner. How many employees do you have?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. We have ten people working for the business currently.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. Okay. And you currently hold your doctorate in rehabilitation counseling from Florida Atlantic University; correct?

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. And what is your doctorate in? What was your thesis?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Well, my concentration was rehabilitation counseling, but I did have to do a doctoral dissertation, and that was specific to brain injury and community reintegration.

entries.speaker: MR. PARKER
entries.text: Q. Okay. And for the jury, would you explain to me what your concentration of rehabilitation counseling entails and what that means generally?

annotations.explanation: The auxiliary verb 'has' is missing, which makes the sentence grammatically incorrect. The correct phrasing is 'has identified'.
This is a comma splice. Two independent clauses are joined by only a comma. A period should be used to separate them, and the following word should be capitalized.

Speaker error. The correct academic term for a doctoral paper is 'dissertation,' not 'thesis.' The transcript accurately reflects the speaker's word choice, so [sic] is used to note the error belongs to the speaker.
